issue: Playwright could silently reuse an Astro preview from a different checkout.

evidenceBefore.config: playwright.config.ts set reuseExistingServer to true on fixed port 4321.
evidenceBefore.listener: The owner of port 4321 was an Astro preview launched from C:/Users/ismay/Development/Tessellate, not this worktree.
evidenceBefore.misleadingResult: The homepage preset test failed at 390px against that other checkout (scrollWidth 691px, clientWidth 342px). The suite was stopped after 150 of 436 tests; those results are discarded.

remediation.behavior: Playwright starts an isolated local server by default, supports a per-run port, and reuses an existing server only after an explicit environment opt-in.

verificationAfter.command: TESSELLATE_ASTRO_PREVIEW_PORT=4322 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home-preset-chips-responsive-step-45.spec.ts --project desktop-chrome
verificationAfter.note: The test ran against this worktree's freshly built Astro artifact; the overlapping 4321 server was left untouched.

fullSuite: A complete test:e2e run against isolated current-worktree servers is still required.
